SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.FORMSTYLE, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, B.SAMPLEORGID, B.NCCODE, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = A.ID AND O.TERMINATION != '1') AS SAMPLEORDERCOUNT, C.ORGNAME AS REPORTORGNAME, D.ACTIVATEDFLAG AS SCHEDULEACTIVEDFLAG FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON A.REPORTORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_SCHEDULE_TASK_CONFIG D ON D."UID" = CONCAT('T_EMC_PROJECT$', A.ID)) T
AND
AND requiredCompleteDate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND requiredCompleteDate < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
AND TO_CHAR(REQUIREDCOMPLETEDATE, 'yyyyq') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyq')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND ( INSTR(CONCAT(CONCAT(',',SAMPLEUSERID),','), CONCAT(CONCAT(',',#{sampleUserId}),',') ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'draft') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done' AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID='') ))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND F.TERMINATION != '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND (INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'logged')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'logged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SAMPLERECEIVERFLAG = '1' AND (O.RUNID IS NULL or O.RUNID=''))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'Preprocessing')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON TM.ID = O.TESTMETHODID WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'logged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (O.RUNID IS NULL or O.RUNID='')
AND TM.TESTMETHODTYPE =#{testMethodType}
AND O.ASSIGN <> '1'
)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJ_SCHEME PS WHERE PS.PROJID = T.ID AND PS.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT M ON R.PROJID = M.ID WHERE R.PROCESSSTATUS='done' AND M.STATUS <> 'cancel' AND R.STATUS = #{folderStatus} AND R.PROJID=T.ID )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT M ON R.PROJID = M.ID WHERE R.PROCESSSTATUS='done' AND M.STATUS <> 'cancel' AND (R.STATUS = 'draw' or R.STATUS = 'done') AND R.PROJID=T.ID )
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = '' )) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE S WHERE S.PROJID = T.ID AND S.STATUS = 'draft'))
AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = '' )) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE S WHERE S.PROJID = T.ID AND S.STATUS != 'draft'))
AND T.STATUS <> 'cancel'
AND (T.SOURCE IS NULL OR T.SOURCE = '')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT R WHERE R.PROJID=T.ID AND R.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'approve%' )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE >= #{samplingStartDate} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE <= #{samplingEndDate} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CBC WHERE CBC.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_PROJECT$',T.ID) AND CBC.STATUS = 'APPROVED' and CBC.TASKNAME = '方案审核' AND CBC.USERID = #{loginUser.id} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_DIRECTOR PD WHERE PD.PROJECTID=T.ID AND PD.EMPID = #{loginUser.id} )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT A.*, B.FORMSTYLE, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, C.ORGNAME AS REPORTORGNAME FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON A.REPORTORGID = C.ID WHERE A.ID = #{id}

SELECT B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, COUNT(*) AS projectCount FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID
GROUP BY B.BIZCATEGORYNAME ORDER BY
B.BIZCATEGORYNAME ASC

SELECT MONTHVALUE, COUNT(*) AS PROJECTCOUNT FROM (SELECT TASKDATE, TO_CHAR(TASKDATE, 'MM') AS MONTHVALUE FROM T_EMC_PROJECT WHERE TASKDATE IS NOT NULL ) T
AND TO_CHAR(TASKDATE, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
GROUP BY MONTHVALUE ORDER BY MONTHVALUE

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.PROJID = A.ID AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND OT.STATUS <> 'done' AND OT.STATUS <> 'audit' ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS ALLAUDIT, (SELECT MAX(ACCEPTEDDATE) FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = A.ID) AS MAXACCEPTEDDATE FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON OT.RUNID = R.ID WHERE OT.PROJID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS = #{orderTaskStatus})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON OT.RUNID = R.ID WHERE OT.PROJID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS !='done' AND OT.RUNID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OT.ANALYSISORGID) AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis') AND T.LASTESTACCEPTEDDATE+ 4 <= sysdate
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON OT.RUNID = R.ID WHERE OT.PROJID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS !='done' AND OT.RUNID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OT.ANALYSISORGID) AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN R ON OT.RUNID = R.ID WHERE OT.PROJID = T.ID AND OT.STATUS ='done' AND OT.RUNID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OT.ANALYSISORGID) AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis')
AND T.STATUS = 'auditFinished' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT WHERE OT.PROJID = T.ID AND T.CREATEDBYORGID ='${loginOrgId}' AND OT.STATUS = 'audit' AND OT.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (T.REPORTEDITUSERID = #{loginUser.id} OR T.REPORTEDITUSERID IS NULL))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
SELECT SUBSTR(PROJNO, 1, LENGTH(PROJNO) - 3) AS PRE, MAX(SUBSTR(PROJNO, -3)) AS AFTER FROM T_EMC_PROJECT GROUP BY SUBSTR(PROJNO, 1, LENGTH(PROJNO) - 3)
SELECT A.* FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A WHERE INSTR( ',' || A.CONTRACTID || ',',',' || #{contractId} || ',' ) > 0

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.FORMSTYLE, B.BIZCATEGORYNAME, B.EDITMONITORINFO, B.SAMPLEORGID, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = A.ID AND O.TERMINATION != '1') AS SAMPLEORDERCOUNT, C.ORGNAME AS REPORTORGNAME, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'cancel' THEN '终止' ELSE '正常' END CANCELSTATUS, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_EMC_AUDIT_RECORD AR WHERE AR.PROJID = A.ID AND TASKNAME = '报告归档' ) > 1 THEN '报告已外发' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_EMC_AUDIT_RECORD AR WHERE AR.PROJID = A.ID AND TASKNAME = '盖章发送' ) > 1 THEN '报告已打印' ELSE '无' END REPORTCHANGEINFO, D.ACTIVATEDFLAG AS SCHEDULEACTIVEDFLAG FROM T_EMC_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY B ON A.BIZCATEGORYID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON A.REPORTORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_SCHEDULE_TASK_CONFIG D ON D."UID" = CONCAT('T_EMC_PROJECT$', A.ID)) T
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND ( INSTR(CONCAT(CONCAT(',',SAMPLEUSERID),','), CONCAT(CONCAT(',',#{sampleUserId}),',') ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'draft') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done' AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID='') ))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O, T_EMC_FOLDER F WHERE O.FOLDERID = F.ID AND F.PROJID = T.ID AND F.PROCESSSTATUS = 'done'
AND (INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR F.SCENEUSERID = #{sampleUserId}) ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE A WHERE A.PROJID = T.ID AND A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'draft%' AND A.STATUS = 'logged')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'logged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SAMPLERECEIVERFLAG = '1' AND (O.RUNID IS NULL or O.RUNID=''))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'Preprocessing')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON TM.ID = O.TESTMETHODID WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'logged' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND (O.RUNID IS NULL or O.RUNID='')
AND TM.TESTMETHODTYPE =#{testMethodType}
AND O.ASSIGN <> '1'
)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND O.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJ_SCHEME PS WHERE PS.PROJID = T.ID AND PS.MONITORTMPLID = #{monitorTmplId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_FOLDER R LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT M ON R.PROJID = M.ID WHERE R.PROCESSSTATUS='done' AND M.STATUS <> 'cancel' AND R.STATUS = #{folderStatus} AND R.PROJID=T.ID )
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = '' )) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE S WHERE S.PROJID = T.ID AND S.STATUS = 'draft'))
AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = '' )) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE S WHERE S.PROJID = T.ID AND S.STATUS != 'draft'))
AND T.STATUS <> 'cancel'
AND (T.SOURCE IS NULL OR T.SOURCE = '')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT R WHERE R.PROJID=T.ID AND R.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'approve%' )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE >= #{samplingStartDate} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.PROJID=T.ID AND O.SAMPLECOMPLETEDATE <= #{samplingEndDate} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT CBC WHERE CBC.TARGETID = CONCAT('T_EMC_PROJECT$',T.ID) AND CBC.STATUS = 'APPROVED' and CBC.TASKNAME = '方案审核' AND CBC.USERID = #{loginUser.id} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT_DIRECTOR PD WHERE PD.PROJECTID=T.ID AND PD.EMPID = #{loginUser.id} )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT A.PRICE, A.PROJID AS PROJPROJID, B.* FROM T_CRM_INVOICE_PROJ@LIMS_CZJKY_HT A LEFT JOIN T_CRM_INVOICE@LIMS_CZJKY_HT B ON A.INVOICEID = B.ID ) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT A.CURPAY, A.PROJID AS PROJPROJID, B.* FROM T_CRM_PAY_PROJECT@LIMS_CZJKY_HT A LEFT JOIN T_CRM_PAYMENT@LIMS_CZJKY_HT B ON A.PAYMENTID = B.ID ) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT projid as id FROM T_CRM_INVOICE_PROJ@LIMS_CZJKY_HT WHERE sourcetype = '环境' UNION SELECT projid as id FROM T_CRM_PAY_PROJECT@LIMS_CZJKY_HT WHERE sourcetype = '环境' ) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT T.*,A.CONTRACTPRICE FROM ( SELECT '环境' AS sourcetype, TO_CHAR(a.id) AS id,TO_CHAR(a.id) AS projid, a.projno , a.projname, '' AS money, a.projectprice AS price, a.projectprice AS nowprice, a.CONTRACTID,a.contractno, a.entrustorgname,a.testorgname,'' AS MAINTESTORGID,'' AS testfee,A.BELONGAREA,'' AS SAMPLENAME,FIRSTISSUEDATETIME AS ISSUREDATE,DELIVERYDATE,ENTRUSTDATE, '' AS ORIGINALTESTFEE,'' AS TESTUSERNAMES, A.CREATEDBYID,A.AMOUNTDETERM, '' AS DISCOUNT,'' AS BIZDEPTCODE,'' AS BIZDEPTNAME,'' AS BIZHOSTUSERID,'' AS BIZHOST FROM t_emc_project a WHERE a.status <> 'cancel' UNION ALL SELECT '食品' AS sourcetype, b.id AS id,b.id AS projid, CASE WHEN INSTR(TLF.FOLDERNO, 'XG') > 0 THEN TLF.FOLDERNO||TLF.RENEWALREPORTNO ELSE TLF.FOLDERNO END AS projno, b.matname AS projname, '' AS money, b.finalmoney AS price,b.finalmoney AS nowprice, b.CONTRACTID,b.contractno,b.AUTHORIZATIONUNIT AS entrustorgname, B.ORGNAME AS testorgname,B.ORGID AS MAINTESTORGID,'' AS testfee,B.AREA AS BELONGAREA,'' AS SAMPLENAME,tlf.WAREHOUSINGTIME AS ISSUREDATE, tlf.OUTBOUNDTIME AS DELIVERYDATE,CASE WHEN b.TEMPLATE IN('chongqing_huagong_choujian','chongqingshiyi_shipin_weituo') THEN b.ACCEPTDATE ELSE b.ACCEPTSUBMITDATE END AS ENTRUSTDATE, '' AS ORIGINALTESTFEE,'' AS TESTUSERNAMES, B.CREATEDBYID,'' AS AMOUNTDETERM, '' AS DISCOUNT,'' AS BIZDEPTCODE,'' AS BIZDEPTNAME,'' AS BIZHOSTUSERID,'' AS BIZHOST FROM T_LIMS_CLEARANCEFORM@LIMS_CZJKY_SP b LEFT JOIN T_LIMS_FOLDERS@LIMS_CZJKY_SP tlf ON b.ID = tlf.CLEARANCEID UNION ALL SELECT '消费品' AS sourcetype, TO_CHAR(c.id) AS id,TO_CHAR(c.id) AS projid, c.projno AS projno , c.samplename AS projname, '' AS money, c.testfee AS price,c.buyprice AS nowprice, TO_CHAR(c.CONTRACTID) AS CONTRACTID,c.contractno,c.entrustorgname,c.MAINTESTORGNAME as testorgname,c.MAINTESTORGID,c.testfee,c.BELONGAREA,c.SAMPLENAME,d.ISSURETIME AS ISSUREDATE,d.ISSURETIME AS DELIVERYDATE, c.ENTRUSTDATE AS ENTRUSTDATE,C.ORIGINALTESTFEE, ( SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ANALYSISUSERNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ANALYSISUSERNAME) FROM T_XFP_ORDER_TASK @LIMS_CZJKY_XFP WHERE PROJID = c.id ) AS TESTUSERNAMES, C.CREATEDBYID,'' AS AMOUNTDETERM, C.DISCOUNT,C.BIZDEPTCODE,C.BIZDEPTNAME,C.BIZHOSTUSERID,C.BIZHOST FROM T_XFP_PROJECT@LIMS_CZJKY_XFP c LEFT JOIN T_XFP_report @LIMS_CZJKY_XFP d ON c.id = d.projid WHERE C.status <> 'suspend' ) T LEFT JOIN T_CRM_CONTRACT@LIMS_CZJKY_HT A ON T.CONTRACTNO = A.CONTRACTNO ) T
ORDER BY
T.SOURCETYPE DESC
